statusDesc.INCOMPLETE: When an administered item has the "Incomplete" status, this means that the submitter wishes to make the community that uses this registry aware of the existence of an administered item, and any associated attached items, in their local domain.
statusDesc.CANDIDATE: When an administered item has the "Candidate" status, this means that the administered item, and any associated attached items, has been proposed for progression through the registration levels.
statusDesc.RECORDED: When an administered item has the "Recorded" status, this means that all mandatory metadata attributes have been completed, all mandatory associations have been instantiated and all associated constraints are to be enforced. The preceding rule also applies to any and all attached items attached to the administered item. An administered item in the "Recorded" status implies that the administered item may be shared across domains.
statusDesc.QUALIFIED: When an administered item has the "Qualified" status, this means that the administered item had a "Recorded" registration status and the registration authority has confirmed that the mandatory metadata attributes are complete and conform to applicable quality requirements.
statusDesc.STANDARD: When an administered item has the "Standard" status, this means that the administered item had a "Qualified" registration status and the registration authority has confirmed that the administered item is of sufficient quality and of broad interest for use in the community that uses this registry.
statusDesc.PREFERRED_STANDARD: When an administered item has the "Preferred Standard" status, this means that the registration authority confirms that the administered item is preferred for use in the community that uses this registry.
statusDesc.SUPERSEDED: When an administered item has the "Superseded" status, this means that the registration authority has determined the administered item is no longer recommended for use in the community that uses this registry. A "Superseded" administered item may be used, but the successor administered item is preferred for use.
statusDesc.RETIRED: When an administered item has the "Retired" status, this means that the registration authority has determined that the administered item is no longer recommended for use in the community that uses this registry. A "Retired" administered item should no longer be used.
statusDesc.HISTORICAL: When an administered item has the "Historical" status, this means that the submitter wishes to make the community that uses this registry aware of the existence of an item that was used in the past and has not been used recently.
statusDesc.APPLICATION: When an administered item has the "Application" status, this means that the registration authority wishes to make the community that uses this registry aware of the existence of an administered item in their local domain that is used by an application system.

statusDetail.INCOMPLETE: An administered item in the status of "Incomplete" in the registry shall not be maintained under version control. The minimum metadata attribute documentation for the "Incomplete" status in the registry shall be as follows: identifier; submitter organization name; submitter contact name; submitter contact information. It is possible that the administered item does not contain all mandatory attribute values, and other constraints specified for particular metadata objects are not enforced.
statusDetail.CANDIDATE: Administered items in the "Candidate" status are maintained under version control. The minimum metadata attribute documentation for the "Candidate" status includes all attributes required for "Incomplete" status, plus the following: stewardship organization name; stewardship contact name; stewardship contact information. It is possible that the administered item does not contain all mandatory attribute values, and other constraints specified for particular metadata objects are not enforced.
statusDetail.RECORDED: All mandatory metadata attributes have been completed, all mandatory associations have been instantiated and all associated constraints are to be enforced; the preceding rule also applies to any and all attached items. An administered item in the "Recorded" status implies that the administered item may be shared across domains; the contents of the mandatory metadata attributes possibly do not conform to quality requirements. The submitter may request the retirement of an administered item in the registration status of "Recorded" at any time. Administered items in "Recorded" registration status or higher are maintained under version control.
statusDetail.QUALIFIED: The administered item had a "Recorded" registration status and the registration authority has confirmed that the mandatory metadata attributes are complete and conform to applicable quality requirements. In the event that an administered item is not approved by the registration authority for the "Qualified" registration status level, it shall remain at the "Recorded" registration status level.
statusDetail.STANDARD: The administered item had a "Qualified" registration status and the registration authority has confirmed that the administered item is of sufficient quality and of broad interest for use in the community that uses this registry. There is possibly more than one "Standard" administered item that addresses the same function, concept, etc.
statusDetail.PREFERRED_STANDARD: The registration authority confirms that the administered item is preferred for use in the community that uses this registry.
statusDetail.SUPERSEDED: The registration authority has determined the administered item is no longer recommended for use in the community that uses this registry. A "Superseded" administered item may be used, but the successor administered item is preferred for use. "Superseded" administered items are retained in the registry archival storage facility for historic reference purposes. "Superseded" administered items should include a reference to the successor administered items. Only editorial edits of "Superseded" administered items are permitted. An administered item can move to "Superseded" status from "Recorded" status or above, so the quality of the attribution is possibly no better than in "Recorded" status.
statusDetail.RETIRED: The registration authority has determined that the administered item is no longer recommended for use in the community that uses this registry. A "Retired" administered item should no longer be used. Such administered items are retained in the registry archival storage facility for historic reference and research purposes. "Retired" administered items should include a reference to replacement administered items when appropriate. Only editorial edits of "Retired" administered items are permitted. An administered item can move to "Retired" status from "Recorded" status or above, so the quality of the attribution is possibly no better than in "Recorded" status.
statusDetail.HISTORICAL: The submitter wishes to make the community that uses this registry aware of the existence of an item that was used in the past and has not been used recently. It is important to record so that related items can be given additional perspective through knowledge of this item. A "Historical" administered item has not passed through the dynamic registration levels. It is possible that the quality of the attribution is no better than in "Incomplete" status.
statusDetail.APPLICATION: The registration authority wishes to make the community that uses this registry aware of the existence of an administered item in their local domain that is used by an application system. It is possible that this item is very well described. It is also possible that the quality of the attribution is no better than in "Incomplete" status. Items with the "Application" status may be from application systems that are in current development.

changeDesc.INCOMPLETE: Not change managed in terms of control committee involvement or approval actions: the submitting organization normally maintains the content of its administered items.
changeDesc.CANDIDATE: Not change managed in terms of control committee involvement or approval actions: normally maintained by the submitting organization and the steward.
changeDesc.RECORDED: Changes require no approval; the metadata registry should automatically notify the associated steward of any changes. May be modified by the submitting organization or the steward.
changeDesc.QUALIFIED: Only the original submitter or the responsible steward may edit; changes should not be made without control committee approval. Change proposals follow the same procedures as new proposals, and the steward should involve the original submitter.
changeDesc.STANDARD: Only the original submitter or the responsible steward may edit; changes should not be made without control committee approval. Change proposals follow the same procedures as new proposals, and the steward should involve the original submitter.
changeDesc.PREFERRED_STANDARD: Only the original submitter or the responsible steward may edit; changes should not be made without control committee approval. Change proposals follow the same procedures as new proposals, and the steward should involve the original submitter.
changeDesc.SUPERSEDED: Only editorial edits are permitted; other changes should not be permitted.
changeDesc.RETIRED: Only editorial edits are permitted; other changes should not be permitted.
changeDesc.APPLICATION: The standard specifies no dedicated change management requirements for this status.
